Title: Ideal model export scenario, maintaining hierarchy 
Description: Hi,

I've picked through the demo's and looked at various approaches but was wondering what the ideal scenario is for importing a model with multiple moving sub parts from 3d max to three.  Would it be to group up the parts, and export each individually to obj files then use the convert_obj_threejs_slim.py script, load each one individually and reconstruct everything in code?  This is what I'm considering as I have a helicopter with moving rotor's guns etc.

It would be awesome if, for example, the car demo showed the wheels moving, so we could see how to load and deal with models built of multiple parts.

If someone could let me know if I'm going down the right path, or if there is a way i could export the model as is and import, maintaining the hierarchy of the model
